discussion_comments.comment_body: The command is offered on the feature flag alone. A user with no GitHub connection or no GitHub remote only finds out after running it. The workspace manifest already records git URL and branch cheaply at session start, and the cloud service can expose GitHub connection state, so this could be gated up front. Dirty state and `ls-remote` should still be checked at run time.

With the privacy link kept only in the Cline Account view, please remove `privacySettingsUrl` and `applyAccountUser` from this context. AccountView already fetches the user and can derive its link there; publishing that user back into the context adds synchronization solely to support the duplicate link in General settings. The app base URL is environment configuration and can be exposed separately from account identity.

both are gone from the context in [`728da6af`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/728da6afab). `AccountView` builds the privacy link from the user it fetches itself. the one non-account value left in the context is [`clineAppBaseUrl`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-51d0e9d12c66cf07b9303f12d282288c397b2e396ae7f1c404a00cebf2b34c7bR33), documented as environment configuration that never follows an account refresh. it stays on this provider because the provider is already mounted at the app root, and a second one would be plumbing for a single value.

Please centralize dashboard URL generation so the resolved app base URL and client attribution apply consistently to all account links. This changes Open dashboard and privacy settings to follow the configured environment, but usage, credits, and organization links still use hardcoded production URLs. A single dashboard URL builder would avoid sending users to different environments from the same account view.

in [`728da6af`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/728da6afab) every link in this view [goes through the builder](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-9523759fe5e95a4c04a7240c757c15da7ba9f4ae6540c8ac15925e4f7bb660a3R164): seven builder calls behind six buttons (dashboard, usage, credits on the user or organization route, create account, create organization, privacy settings). that was six hardcoded `app.cline.bot` constants at the merge base and none now. an unresolved app URL leaves each link undefined and its button hidden instead of falling back to production, which also covers proxy and self-hosted backends, where every link but privacy settings used to open production. [`281db607`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/281db607f0) applies the same builder to the desktop onboarding, connectors and welcome links.
